# Data licences

## Generated by this project

- `data/synthetic/` and every `data/processed/<pack>/planned_projects.csv` while marked `synthetic=true`:
  released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- `data/processed/<pack>/` indicator files: derived from the sources in `data/raw/<pack>/`. Each value's source and
  licence is recorded row by row in `indicators_long.csv`. While a value is a flagged placeholder it is generated,
  not data.

## Third-party inputs to `data/reference/<pack>/`

`scripts/build_reference.py` builds these files. The licence of each boundary file follows its geoBoundaries
source (release 9469f09). Attribution is required for all of them.

| Pack | Boundaries source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| BR | geoBoundaries BRA ADM1 (Wikimedia Commons) | CC BY 2.5 |
| BR-AL | geoBoundaries BRA ADM2 (IBGE, OCHA ROLAC) | CC BY 3.0 IGO |
| RU, RU-TY | geoBoundaries RUS ADM1/ADM2 (OpenStreetMap, Wambacher) | **ODbL 1.0**: © OpenStreetMap contributors. The derived boundary files are shared under ODbL |
| IN | geoBoundaries IND ADM1 (DataMeet, Election Commission of India) | CC BY 2.5 India |
| IN-MH | geoBoundaries IND ADM2 (Pathways Data, lgdirectory.gov.in) | **ODbL 1.0**. The derived boundary file is shared under ODbL |
| CN | geoBoundaries CHN ADM1 (Wikimedia Commons) | Public domain |
| CN-NX | geoBoundaries CHN ADM2 (NASMG, Revolutionary GIS) | ODC PDDL 1.0 |
| ZA, ZA-EC | geoBoundaries ZAF ADM1/ADM2 (Municipal Demarcation Board, OCHA ROSEA) | CC BY 3.0 IGO |

Boundaries are for planning maps only and imply no position on any disputed border.

Populations:
- All packs except BR-AL and IN-MH: modelled from
  [Kontur Population 2023-11-01](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset-3km) (CC BY 4.0), summed
  inside each boundary. Marked `population_verified=false`.
- BR-AL: IBGE Censo Demográfico 2022, table 4709 (public; cite IBGE). Municipality list and codes from the IBGE
  localities API.
- IN-MH: Census of India 2011 (GODL-India), marked unverified until checked against the Primary Census Abstract.

Government of India data is used under the Government Open Data License – India (GODL); attribution is required.
